YOUR DEMO REQUEST

PRIVACY NOTICE

Updated 27 November 2026

What you share

When you request a demo, we ask for your name, email, optional business name, project message, preferred date and time, timezone, and permission to contact you about your request.

How we use it

Manglo Studio, led by Faik Hameed Mulla in India, uses these details to respond to your enquiry, understand your project, and arrange a conversation. A demo request does not subscribe you to marketing or reserve a calendar appointment.

Where your request goes

Your request is sent to faik@manglo.shop through Hostinger Mail. The website server keeps a protected record of the enquiry and its delivery status outside the public website directory. Relevant Manglo Studio team members may use it to respond. Data may be processed in India and where our hosting and email providers operate.

Storage and website services

Enquiry records on the website server are retained for up to 90 days and then removed during routine cleanup. Copies of emails may remain in the business mailbox for follow-up and record keeping; contact us if you want your enquiry removed. We do not use advertising trackers or analytics cookies on this site. Fonts used by this site are hosted with the website.

Your choices

You can ask to access, correct, or delete your enquiry, or ask us to stop contacting you, by emailing faik@manglo.shop. Please avoid sending sensitive personal information in the project message.
